title: SafeStep Program Fees and Employer Invoicing Schedule
content:
# Administration Fee and Invoicing Schedule — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program

Accounts receivable schedule of the annual program administration fee rates, the minimum annual administration fee, the way redemptions are invoiced to the employer, and the window for disputing a billed redemption. Amounts in US dollars.

| Tier | Annual administration fee per participant on the roster at the start of the allowance year | Minimum annual administration fee | How redemptions are invoiced to the employer | Calendar days after the invoice date to dispute a billed redemption |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 6.00 | 150.00 | Per redemption | 30 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 5.00 | 250.00 | Per redemption | 30 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 4.00 | 400.00 | Monthly consolidated | 30 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 3.50 | 700.00 | Monthly consolidated | 45 |
| SafeStep Premier | 3.00 | 1500.00 | Monthly consolidated | 45 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 2.00 | 3000.00 | Monthly consolidated | 60 |

## Schedule notes

- **Per redemption** invoicing is used on SafeStep Voucher Basic and SafeStep Voucher Plus; the four higher tiers are invoiced **monthly consolidated**.
- The per-participant rate falls as the tier rises, from 6.00 on SafeStep Voucher Basic to 2.00 on SafeStep Enterprise, while the minimum annual fee rises from 150.00 to 3000.00.
- The dispute window is counted in calendar days from the invoice date.
